note: Views Add Button adds a configurable entity 'add' button to Views. Real surface: two Views handlers registered by hook_views_data_alter() on the 'views' table - area handler views_add_button_area (field views_add_button, shown as 'Global: Entity Add Button') and field handler views_add_button_field. Handler options (schema views.area.views_add_button_area / views.field.views_add_button_field) include type ('<entity_type>+<bundle>'), button_text, button_classes, query_string, context, destination, tokenize, render_plugin, access_plugin. URL/access come from @ViewsAddButton plugins (plugin.manager.views_add_button, namespace Plugin/views_add_button) selected by target_entity: built-ins views_add_button_node (node.add), _taxonomy, _user, _eck_entity, _default (fallback /{type}/add/{bundle}). No configure route, permissions, or Drush; requires views + token. Medium cases read back a seeded view's add-button options (button_text, button_classes); hard cases add the area and field handlers to a base view, verified against the saved view config. ENV NOTE: saving a View on this shared site can trigger an unrelated group-module error during route rebuild; the save persists and the separate verify script reads correct live state.

evals.prompt: How do I add an 'add content' button to the top of a Drupal View using the views_add_button module, and what is the handler called in the Views UI?
evals.expected_output: Add the 'Global: Entity Add Button' area (handler views_add_button_area) to the view's Header (or Footer), or add the 'Entity Add Button' field (views_add_button_field). Then choose the entity type/bundle and button text. No settings page is needed.

evals.prompt: What can I configure on a views_add_button 'Entity Add Button', and can the options use tokens?
evals.expected_output: You configure the target entity type/bundle (type as '<entity_type>+<bundle>'), button text, button classes (to style the <a> as a button), a query string, an entity context, prefix/suffix/access-denied HTML, a destination toggle, and tokenize. Every option except the Entity Type supports tokens; tokenize pulls values from the first result row.

evals.prompt: How does views_add_button work out the correct 'add' URL and create-access for different entity types, and how would I support a custom entity?
evals.expected_output: It uses @ViewsAddButton plugins selected by target_entity: built-ins for node (node.add route), taxonomy_term, user, ECK, and a Default plugin that assumes /{entity_type}/add/{bundle}. To support a custom entity, add your own @ViewsAddButton plugin implementing generateUrl()/checkAccess() (or set render_plugin/access_plugin on the handler).

evals.prompt: On this site there is a View with id 'vab_probe' that uses views_add_button. Inspect the live view configuration and tell me the button text configured for its Entity Add Button.
evals.expected_output: The vab_probe view's header has a views_add_button_area handler (targeting node+article) with button_text = 'Add Article'.

evals.prompt: The View 'vab_probe2' on this site has a views_add_button Entity Add Button. Inspect the live view configuration and tell me the CSS classes (button_classes) applied to its add button.
evals.expected_output: The vab_probe2 view's footer views_add_button_area handler has button_classes = 'vab-cta-button'.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a View named 'vab_view' listing content. Using the views_add_button module, add an Entity Add Button to the view's header that links to the Article ('node' / 'article') add form, and save it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Add a header (or footer) area handler with plugin_id views_add_button_area (field views_add_button, table views), type 'node+article', to the vab_view view and save it - e.g. via the Views UI 'Global: Entity Add Button' area or by editing display_options.header in the view config.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a View named 'vab_fview'. Using the views_add_button module, add an Entity Add Button as a Views field (per-row) to that view and save it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Add a field handler with plugin_id views_add_button_field (field views_add_button_field, table views) to the vab_fview view and save it - e.g. via the Views UI 'Entity Add Button' field or by editing display_options.fields in the view config.
